item.title: From ‘communist lunatic’ to ‘rational person': Donald Trump takes a U-turn on Zohran Mamdani
item.description: In a stunning political pivot, President Trump met with mayor-elect Zohran Mamdani, exchanging warmth instead of the expected animosity. Despite past harsh criticisms, Trump praised Mamdani as "rational" and pledged support, surprising observers. Both leaders signaled a commitment to cooperation on key issues like affordability and public safety, setting aside campaign hostilities for pragmatic collaboration.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Donald Trump and Zohran Mamdani meeting: 10 key moments from White House Oval Office
item.description: In a surprising White House meeting, Donald Trump and Mayor-elect Zohran Mamdani found common ground on New York City's future, despite stark ideological differences. Trump expressed a desire for Mamdani's success, emphasizing the city's importance. Discussions touched on immigration and public safety, with both leaders prioritizing a strong NYC, showcasing a rare moment of bipartisan cooperation.

item.title: Who is Shumeet Banerji? Indian-origin BBC board member who quit over 'governance failures'
item.description: Shumeet Banerji resigned from the BBC board citing serious governance issues and a lack of consultation on executive departures. His exit highlights deeper structural concerns at the broadcaster, particularly following a controversial Panorama episode misrepresenting Donald Trump's speech. Banerji's departure raises questions about editorial oversight and accountability ahead of parliamentary scrutiny.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Ukraine-Russia conflict: Putin welcomes US peace plan as 'final settlement'; Trump urges Zelenskyy to respond
item.description: In a diplomatic twist, President Putin of Russia expressed a measured acceptance of a US proposal aimed at peace in Ukraine, indicating it might pave the way for a resolution. However, he criticized Kyiv for what he termed as an unrealistic stance.

item.title: MAGA vs socialism: Why Zohran Mamdani's meeting with Donald Trump is a big deal
item.description: New York City Mayor-elect Zohran Mamdani is set to meet with President Donald Trump, signaling a potential for cooperation despite their sharp ideological differences and history of public hostility. The meeting focuses on New York's affordability crisis, housing, transit, and public safety, with both leaders aiming to address key voter concerns.

item.description: In an unexpected twist, President Trump looks forward to a 'constructive' discussion with the newly elected Mayor of New York City, Zohran Mamdani, even amidst their past disagreements. Trump complimented Mamdani's impressive campaign, recognizing that while their ideas may clash, they ultimately share a vision for a thriving New York City.

item.title: Who is Eric Swalwell? Democrat from East Bay joins California governor’s race
item.description: Eric Swalwell, a vocal critic of Donald Trump, has officially launched his campaign for California governor. The East Bay congressman announced his bid on Jimmy Kimmel's show, focusing on affordability, public safety, and economic growth. His platform highlights his long-standing opposition to the former president, aiming to resonate with California Democrats.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: DOJ, FBI probe top Trump admin officials over alleged case interference; political motives in question
item.description: US Justice Department officials are reportedly investigating two senior Trump officials, Ed Martin and Bill Pulte, for allegedly interfering in criminal probes targeting President Trump's political rivals. Sources claim sensitive grand jury information may have been shared and outside parties involved in reviewing evidence against Adam Schiff and Letitia James. This alleged interference could compromise ongoing investigations.

item.title: “People know where I stand on EVERYTHING”: xQc fires back at Pokimane’s take on modern streaming as creators clash over drama-driven content
item.description: Streamers xQc and Pokimane's long-standing rivalry has resurfaced. xQc criticized Pokimane's recent comments on streaming's current state, blaming her for the very issues she raised. This exchange reignites their feud, which began in 2021, with Ludwig Ahgren attempting to mediate the ongoing online spat.
item.dc:creator: Global Sports Desk

item.title: Ex-Harvard prez Larry Summers and wife flew to Epstein’s ‘island’ on 2005 honeymoon for a ‘brief visit’, report claims
item.description: Larry Summers, the former president of Harvard University, is under fire as newly released flight logs show he vacationed on Jeffrey Epstein's private island in 2005, alongside Ghislaine Maxwell. While Summers' spokesperson maintained that the trip occurred before Epstein's first arrest, revelations of additional flights on Epstein's plane and correspondence with the notorious pedophile have sparked a fierce backlash.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Candace Owens drops explosive claim on Charlie Kirk's assassination with shocking twist about Tyler Robinson fingerprints
item.description: Candace Owens questions the official narrative surrounding Charlie Kirk's shooting, suggesting a planned setup involving multiple individuals. She claims Tyler Robinson's role was limited, with his fingerprints not being the only ones on the weapon. Owens also alleges Lance Twiggs played a more significant, albeit different, part in the incident, citing a TMZ video as evidence.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: What did RaKai tell QTCinderella that made Ludwig react to the teen streamer’s comments?
item.description: Twitch streamer RaKai's viral video praising QTCinderella's appearance at The Streamer Awards 2025 sparked a reaction from her boyfriend, Ludwig Ahgren. Ludwig expressed discomfort with a 16-year-old commenting on his girlfriend, leading to online discussion. RaKai later apologized, claiming he didn't intend to be rude and that the clip was made by "AI."
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: Candace Owens raises heat while claiming Erika Kirk is on autopilot and holds no verifiable lies after Charlie Kirk was killed
item.description: Candace Owens voiced suspicions following Charlie Kirk's death, questioning the narrative and highlighting unusual flight path overlaps involving his wife, Erika Kirk, and Egyptian military planes. Owens also cast doubt on the identified shooter, suggesting a larger conspiracy. She emphasized her focus remains on the group surrounding Kirk and the unexplained circumstances.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: ‘Why not take the train? Is that first class?’: Laura Loomer mocks socialist Mamdani for taking a plane
item.description: In a recent social media stir, New York’s incoming mayor, Zohran Mamdani, sparked controversy with a plane selfie that caught the ire of conservative pundit Laura Loomer. Loomer seized the opportunity to challenge Mamdani's authenticity as a self-proclaimed socialist, suggesting his travel choices contradicted his political stance.

item.title: 'Painful concessions': Zelenskyy on Donald Trump's 28-point Russia-Ukraine peace plan; what's proposed
item.description: A 28-point peace framework, reportedly drafted by US and Russian officials with Trump's backing, proposes Ukraine cede territory and weapons. Kyiv would recognize Russian control over Crimea, Luhansk, and Donetsk, and abandon NATO aspirations. The plan also outlines US security guarantees tied to compensation and financial benefits for Washington.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Zohran Mamdani and Donald Trump meeting: What to expect — and what’s on agenda
item.description: In a surprising twist, New York City’s newly elected Mayor Zohran Mamdani will sit down with President Trump at the White House. This unexpected dialogue follows a history of pointed critiques between the two leaders. The agenda? Tackling NYC's affordability crisis, bolstering economic stability, and enhancing public safety.
